        maltype = "Downloader"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"

        $beacon_config = { 2E 00 62 00 65 00 61 00 63 00 6F 00 6E 00 } // ".beacon" in unicode
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $http_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $xor_key = { 00 00 00 00 } // Common null XOR key
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // MZ header
        filesize < 500KB and
        all of ($$beacon*)
}

    ParentImage|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-nop', '-w', 'hidden', 'encodedcommand'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566.001/
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts (rare)
author: SOC Team

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon loading via rundll32"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    strings:
        $a = "beacon.dll" fullword ascii
        $b = "Start" fullword ascii
        $c = "rundll32.exe" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
